LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), unique_bridge_keys AS ( SELECT sscsdm,bridge_key,min(bridge_id) AS bridge_id FROM bridge_keys GROUP BY sscsdm,bridge_key HAVING count(*)=1 ), regular_candidate_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sscsdm,id FROM dwd_ql_jg_cgdj_inc WHERE qlid=#{id} ), regular_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(r.sscsdm,r.id) r.* FROM dwd_ql_jg_cgdj_inc r JOIN regular_candidate_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.id]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.id]::text[] ORDER BY r.sscsdm,r.id,r.sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,r.xgsj DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), regular_for_bridge AS ( SELECT r.* FROM regular_latest r JOIN bridge_active b ON ARRAY[b.sscsdm,b.qlid]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.qlid]::text[] WHERE b.qlid=#{id} ), task_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT rwid FROM regular_for_bridge WHERE nullif(trim(rwid),'') IS NOT NULL ), task_candidate_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.sscsdm,r.id FROM dwd_ql_jg_cgdj_inc r JOIN task_ids t ON t.rwid=r.rwid ), task_regular_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(r.sscsdm,r.id) r.* FROM dwd_ql_jg_cgdj_inc r JOIN task_candidate_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.id]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.id]::text[] ORDER BY r.sscsdm,r.id,r.sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,r.xgsj DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), task_bridge_counts AS ( SELECT r.rwid,count(DISTINCT b.qlid)::integer AS related_bridge_count FROM task_regular_latest r JOIN task_ids t ON t.rwid=r.rwid JOIN bridge_active b ON ARRAY[b.sscsdm,b.qlid]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.qlid]::text[] GROUP BY r.rwid ), attachment_candidate_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.id FROM dwd_ql_js_fjxxb_inc f JOIN regular_for_bridge r ON r.id=f.fid UNION SELECT DISTINCT f.id FROM dwd_ql_js_fjxxb_inc f JOIN task_ids t ON t.rwid=f.fid ), attachment_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(f.id) f.* FROM dwd_ql_js_fjxxb_inc f JOIN attachment_candidate_ids k ON k.id=f.id ORDER BY f.id,f.sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,f.xgsj DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(f)::text DESC ), regular_unique_ids AS ( SELECT id FROM dwd_ql_jg_cgdj_inc GROUP BY id HAVING count(DISTINCT sscsdm)=1 ), task_file_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.id FROM ql_sys_file f JOIN task_ids t ON t.rwid=f.p_id ), task_file_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(f.id) f.* FROM ql_sys_file f JOIN task_file_ids k ON k.id=f.id ORDER BY f.id,f.update_date DESC NULLS LAST,f.create_time DESC NULLS LAST,f.version DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(f)::text DESC ), reports AS ( SELECT 'base-'||b.qlid AS id,b.qlmc||'检测报告' AS name,'底数关联检测报告'::text AS type,b.jcrq::timestamp AS time,b.jcbg AS path, 'BASE_INSPECTION'::text AS source,b.qlid AS inspection_id,NULL::integer AS inspection_type,b.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at, NULL::text AS task_id,NULL::integer AS related_bridge_count FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'inspection-'||r.bsm,coalesce(nullif(trim(r.mc),''),'定期检测报告'),'定期检测报告',r.jcsj,r.fj, 'PERIODIC_INSPECTION',r.bsm,r.jclx,r.tbsj,NULL::text,NULL::integer FROM inspection_latest r JOIN unique_bridge_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.jcdx]::text[] WHERE k.bridge_id=#{id} AND coalesce(r.sjtbzt,'')!='D' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN 'regular-'||r.sscsdm||'-'||r.id ELSE 'attachment-'||f.id END, coalesce(nullif(f.mc,''),nullif(f.name,''),r.jcnd::text||'年常规定检报告','常规定检报告'),'常规定检报告',r.wcsj,coalesce(nullif(f.wjurldz,''),f.lj), 'REGULAR_INSPECTION',r.id,1,r.sjtbsj,r.rwid,NULL::integer FROM regular_for_bridge r LEFT JOIN attachment_latest f ON f.fid=r.id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM regular_unique_ids u WHERE u.id=r.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'bridge-attachment-'||b.qlid,b.qlmc||'桥梁附件','桥梁图片及附件',NULL::timestamp,b.fj, 'BRIDGE_ATTACHMENT',NULL::text,NULL::integer,b.sjtbsj,NULL::text,NULL::integer FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=#{id} AND nullif(trim(b.fj),'') IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'task-attachment-'||f.id,coalesce(nullif(f.mc,''),nullif(f.name,''),'共享任务附件'),'共享定检任务附件',NULL::timestamp, coalesce(nullif(f.wjurldz,''),f.lj),'TASK_ATTACHMENT',NULL::text,1,f.sjtbsj::timestamp,t.rwid,c.related_bridge_count FROM task_ids t JOIN attachment_latest f ON f.fid=t.rwid JOIN task_bridge_counts c ON c.rwid=t.rwid UNION ALL SELECT 'task-file-'||f.id,coalesce(nullif(f.display_name,''),nullif(f.name,''),'共享任务文件'),'共享定检任务附件',NULL::timestamp, f.path,'TASK_FILE',NULL::text,1,coalesce(f.update_date,f.create_time),t.rwid,c.related_bridge_count FROM task_ids t JOIN task_file_latest f ON f.p_id=t.rwid JOIN task_bridge_counts c ON c.rwid=t.rwid ) SELECT id,name,type,time,path,source,inspection_id,inspection_type,source_updated_at,task_id,related_bridge_count FROM reports WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=#{id}) ORDER BY
